title: M.E. Gilcher, Lawyer Of The United Petroleum Trust Of USSR (Soyuzneft)

page_data.en:
Fm. 2
G. 35000-1-34

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date 6 / 1 / 34
Janry. 6, 1934.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Files No. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5714
Branch Socles
Date 6 / 1 / 34）

Subject (in full) M.E. Gilcher, lawyer of the United Petroleum Trust of
U.S.S.R. (Soyuzneft).
Made by D.S. Tcheremshanaky Forwarded by A. J. McEuen

Information has been received that Michael Emanuilovitch
Gilcher is the legal adviser of the United Petroleum Trust of
U.S.S.R. (Soyuzneft). His fee is $250 per mensem. His office
is at No.24 The Bund, Room 3.
Gilcher is a Russian Jew, born on January 31, 1874 at
Herson.
Before the revolution Gilcher was a barrister-at-law at
Petrograd and was regarded as a wealthy man. In 1917 he went
to Harbin from Petrograd and worked there as a lawyer and was
connected with Soviet circles. Gilcher arrived at Shanghai
from Harbin in October, 1930. He worked at Shanghai with one
P.S. Kraslavsky, a suspected Soviet Agent, who is also a lawyer
of the Russian Jewish origin. (File D.2179, D.3017 and D.4749).
A few months ago they dissolved their partnership.
The agreement between the United Petroleum Trust of the
U.S.S.R. (Soyuzneft) and Kwang Hwa Petroleum Company, a Chinese
firm distributing Soviet Nafth products in Central and South
China, was drawn up with Gilcher's assistance when he acted as
a lawyer of the Soyuzneft.
Gilcher married Baronessa Ferzen. They have one daughter,
Vera, who married one G.C.V. Baron Rosen residing in Paris.
Mr. Gilcher resides at No.83 Route Delastre.

（批：1/28）

Tcheremshansky
D. S.

Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch.
（签名）
MAR 7 1934

日期 1934年1月6日）

事由（全称） M.E. Gilcher，苏联联合石油托拉斯（Soyuzneft）律师。
撰写人 D.S. Tcheremshanaky 转呈人 A. J. McEuen

据获情报，Michael Emanuilovitch Gilcher 系苏联联合石油托拉斯（Soyuzneft）的法律顾问。其月薪为250美元。其办公地点位于外滩24号3室。
Gilcher 系俄国犹太人，1874年1月31日出生于赫尔松（Herson）。
革命前，Gilcher 曾在彼得格勒担任出庭律师，并被视为富人。1917年，他从彼得格勒前往哈尔滨，在那里从事律师工作，并与苏维埃圈子有联系。Gilcher 于1930年10月从哈尔滨抵达上海。他在上海与 P.S. Kraslavsky 共事，后者是一名涉嫌的苏维埃特工，也是俄裔犹太律师。（档案 D.2179、D.3017 和 D.4749）。数月前，他们解散了合伙关系。
苏联联合石油托拉斯（Soyuzneft）与光华石油公司（Kwang Hwa Petroleum Company，一家在华中和华南地区分销苏联石油产品的中国公司）之间的协议，是在 Gilcher 担任 Soyuzneft 律师期间，由其协助起草的。
Gilcher 娶了 Ferzen 男爵夫人（Baronessa Ferzen）。他们育有一女 Vera，嫁给了居住在巴黎的 G.C.V. Rosen 男爵。
Gilcher 先生居住于德拉司特路（Route Delastre）83号。

（批注：1/28）

Tcheremshansky
D. S.

副总监，
特别支部。
（签名）
1934年3月7日
